title: Hermite products of correlated Gaussian projections
source_anchor: Complete source-only.json statement and proof topology.
target_statement: Let \(E\) be a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel structure, and let \(\gamma=\operatorname{stdGaussian}(E)\). Let \(u,v\in E\) satisfy \(\|u\|=\|v\|=1\), and put \(\rho=\langle u,v\rangle\). Let \(H_k\) denote the unnormalized probabilists’ Hermite polynomial, defined by \(H_0=1\) and \(H_{k+1}(t)=tH_k(t)-H_k^{\prime}(t)\). For every pair of natural degrees \(i,j\), the literal product \(x\mapsto H_i(\langle u,x\rangle)H_j(\langle v,x\rangle)\) is absolutely integrable under \(\gamma\). Its integral is \(i!\rho^i\) if \(i=j\), and zero if \(i\ne j\). Both degrees can be zero, and coincident or antipodal unit directions are included.
